item.summary: fix: streamed replies rescan the whole accumulated buffer on every delta to test an 8-character silent-reply token (#129130) * fix(auto-reply): bail on length before scanning the streamed buffer for a silent-reply prefix isSilentReplyPrefixText ran trimStart() plus two full toUpperCase() passes over its input before the first length-sensitive test. Its hot caller startTypingOnText is invoked per streamed partial with the accumulated reply text, making the check O(n) per delta and O(n^2) per reply. Hoist tokenUpper and reject candidates longer than the token first. Unicode upper-casing never shortens a string, so trimmed.length > tokenUpper.length already implies tokenUpper.startsWith(normalized) is false. Also folds the duplicate toUpperCase(). * refactor(auto-reply): condense silent-prefix invariant Co-authored-by: Tran Quang --------- Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger
